members.headline: PMK 131/2024: Tarif PPN Sebelas-Dua Belas
members.note: Verbatim title from content/sources.json (id-pajak-pmk131). The primary rule: 12 percent applies to luxury goods under PPnBM, and non-luxury keeps an effective 11 percent through the 11/12 nilai lain base. Grounding for the CF-5 scale panel, which ships only if A7 can put a sourced denominator against a sourced numerator.
